triggers.name: Betrayer
triggers.tooltip: Dodging attacks causes $804336s2% off-hand Weapon Damage to attackers and enrages your party and raid members within $520256a1 yds, increasing their critical strike chance by $520256s1% for $520256d.
triggers.per_trigger_text: causes off-hand Weapon Damage to attackers
triggers.observe_source: EffectTriggerSpell[0] of 300476 (804336). AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp:42-47 passes an incoming dodge (not a landed or parried swing) when Chance(player, 300476) succeeds (300476 ProcChance 100, so every dodge) and :223-224 casts 804336 at the attacker and 520256 on the caster. An aggressive striker (creature 36) swings at the caster, who wears Evasion 26669 (+50% dodge) refreshed before every 2000 ms attempt as a precondition fixture (the trigger action avoided, ADR 0709); every dodged (victim_state 2) or parried (victim_state 3) swing is a trial and the spell_cast_count of 804336 must match it. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 804336: 3 damage events in 2 logs (14 to 74); 520256: 42 aura applications and 42 removals in 2 logs; nothing decides a value.
triggers.trial_attempts_reason: An attempt is one striker swing interval; only the dodged or parried swings are trials (Evasion gives +50% dodge, the rest hit or miss), so 2.5 times the swings are scheduled to reach the trigger trials.
